regressionPrerequisites: Existing Node >=22.9 and Linux bash/dirname. Full lifecycle requires an explicitly supplied fresh production-initialized synthetic workspace with this stack and native dependencies already prepared, plus a separately authorized network-denied executor. Tests do not prepare dependencies. Required below-minimum engine qualification requires an existing ARTIFACT_TEST_OLD_NODE binary; a missing executor is blocked, not an optional skip.
authority: Requires separate isolated runtime and dependency preparation authorization; not executable in the source/static milestone.

cases.name: preflight-no-mutation
cases.expect: Reject before destination, cache or dependency writes; never global install.

cases.name: installer-isolation-and-scaffold
cases.sourceCoverage: UNRUN production-wrapper installer stub records arguments/scaffold and intentionally fails; standalone and ancestor workspace sentinels. Not real npm qualification.
cases.expect: Installer targets only the new project with distinct private configs and stripped ambient npm overrides. Both config files are admitted/fingerprinted. Real npm installation must separately verify unchanged ancestor sentinels; stub tests cannot prove package-manager behavior.

cases.name: archive-containment
cases.expect: Validate the complete in-memory inventory before any destination creation; no external extraction.

cases.name: redirected-admission
cases.expect: Reject before staging/preparation writes. Marker alone never admits a workspace.

cases.name: production-cwd-and-stack
inputs: documented init from unrelated parent CWD
bundle absolute path from unrelated CWD
bundle relative path from project parent
cases.expect: Prepare all direct pins and lock locally; type/build every archived component. Reproduce any export failure against this stack before API correction.

cases.name: offline-final-file
cases.sourceCoverage: UNRUN prepared lifecycle adds SVG/font imports, URL/raw queries and CSS font URL build assertions. Synthetic font bytes only exercise URL processing, not decoding/rendering; browser coverage remains missing.
cases.expect: Prepared-only type/build emits one HTML; final-file browser assertions verify behavior and zero required external requests. Do not substitute source inspection.

cases.name: second-bundle-and-extras
cases.expect: Replace only recorded unchanged output; preserve modified/unknown/extras and root paths. No manifest, lock or config mutation.

cases.name: failed-staged-publication
cases.sourceCoverage: UNRUN copied-helper faults cover early prior-bundle/receipt reads and postreservation temp setup. Inliner/receipt rename/interruption/concurrent-writer and stage-identity capture/replacement qualification remain missing.
cases.expect: Read rollback state before stage reservation; guard all subsequent setup with identity-aware cleanup. Never remove an unidentified/replaced stage. Build/inlining failure preserves prior output and baseline. Ordinary receipt failure restores only unchanged just-published bytes; interrupted/concurrent unknown state is refused on rerun and reported, not erased.

cases.name: missing-local-dependency
cases.expect: No installer/network fallback, no manifests/locks/config changes; missing preparation fails without publication.

cases.name: incidental-cache-temp
inputs: ambient NODE_COMPILE_CACHE outside output with disabling set to 0
before/after workspace and disposable HOME inventory
cases.expect: Wrappers disable ambient Node caching/preloads before startup. All helper-owned stage/cache/temp writes stay under reserved .artifact-output. Unknown extras/stale stages are not adopted or recursively cleaned; no HOME/root-dist mutations. Detect incidental package writes rather than assume containment.
